name: Data processing agreement (DPA)
short_description: A data processing agreement (DPA) is the contract between a data controller and a data processor that governs how personal data is processed on the controller's behalf, including sub-processors, security measures and breach notification, as required by GDPR Article 28.

evidence.quote: The same columns existed across NDAs, MSAs, SOWs and DPAs. Different templates. Same truths.
